$comment: The show itself, for 'About the show'; the new-voices section; interview material; performable threads. Phrases and link patterns are case-insensitive regexes matched against post text, link URLs and link titles. Nothing here names people to feature.

performableThreads.$comment: Threads a writer could stage word for word. All conditions must hold. avoidPatterns are case-insensitive regexes for hostile wording; any match rejects the thread. prefetch: how many candidate threads are fetched in full with getPostThread so they are complete.

newVoices.$comment: Members the ledger says the show has never featured, ranked by the sum of their three best post scores in the window.

interview.$comment: See README 'Interview material'. A parent is a question if a '?' falls in its last questionTailChars characters, or it starts with an interrogative word and is short; a prompt if it is short and matches a promptPattern.
